summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes undeclared obfuscated payload via downloaded Bun
details: The package's preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub release assets, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it to run `math_init.js` — a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundle (rotated string-array, hex-encoded identifiers) shipped at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is not listed in `package.json`'s `files` array (which declares only `dist` and `src`), and the advertised library code in `dist/` is small, unobfuscated, and unrelated to that blob. The payload is reachable only via the dropped Bun runtime, which evades Node-based tooling. The package is published under the `@servicetitan` npm scope with a `repository.url` pointing at `github.com/servicetitan/playground.git`, inconsistent with any documented ServiceTitan project and consistent with scope impersonation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
